description: A stereo delay with a send and return around each channel's repeats, so another effect can be put inside the feedback path

params.text: Sets that channel's delay, 0 to 10 seconds, read out in milliseconds on the display above it
Sets how much of that channel's repeats are fed back for the next one, silence to full
Filters that channel's repeats: below the middle a lowpass closes down on them, above it a highpass opens up
Makes the left FDBK knob set the feedback for both channels
Makes the left COLOR knob set the colour for both channels
Crossfades between the incoming signal and the repeats, for both channels at once
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks
Empties that channel's delay line, so the repeats already in it stop

inputs.text: Added to that channel's TIME knob, a second per volt
Added to that channel's FDBK knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to that channel's COLOR knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
The point where that channel's treated repeats come back in; with that channel's SND output patched and this jack unpatched its repeats and feedback both fall silent
Added to the MIX knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
The signal that goes into that channel of the delay
A trigger here takes the effect out of the circuit, and a second trigger puts it back
A trigger here empties that channel's delay line

outputs.text: That channel's repeats before they are fed back, for another effect to work on
That channel's delayed signal blended with the incoming one

notes: Patching a channel's SND output takes that channel's COLOR filter out of the circuit; its repeats leave at SND, and the RTN jack feeds its delay line again.

inputs.11: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
